Visiting undergraduate students

Information for visiting students who wish to study at Eastvale for one or two terms while enrolled elsewhere. Visiting students are not degree candidates.

How to apply

The application process for visiting students runs twice a year. Submit your application, the application requirements checklist, and a letter from your home institution. Contact the admissions office with questions about your application.

Admissions deadlines

The application deadline for visiting students is 15 July 2026 for the autumn term.

Cost of attendance

Visiting students are charged tuition of $7,778.25 per class. Housing for visiting students is $11,600 for the term.

Tests and scores

Our standardized testing policy for visiting students is that the SAT or ACT is required.

English language requirements

Visiting students must show English language proficiency with an IELTS minimum overall band of 6.0.
